narrative.overview: An editorial research notebook after dark: ink-blue surfaces, generous typography, soft mint interaction and a geometric network illustration. An interactive cybersecurity explorer extends this atmosphere with connected educational concepts. Premium restraint keeps real research readable. Homepage mode is Experience; articles are Read; admin, editor and login are Operate.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial hierarchy and generous negative space.
Ink surfaces, mint actions and restrained cyan illustration detail.
Evidence before claims; accessible interaction before decoration.

rules.name: The Readable Evidence Rule
rules.body: Body and metadata target at least 4.5:1 contrast. Selection reverses ink and mint. Carets and consent checkboxes use mint.

dos: Do use database records for research, categories and credentials.
Do preserve keyboard focus, semantic links, readable text contrast and reduced motion.
Do keep article text at a comfortable 75ch maximum.
Do preserve the static concept map, HTML selection and camera controls, reduced-motion behavior and explicit illustrative labeling.
donts: Don't invent research, accomplishments, availability or monitoring telemetry.
Don't make content wait for JavaScript entrance effects or the optional Three.js scene.
Don't treat decorative borders as a substitute for control focus.
